parameters.name: AppType
parameters.description:
The type of the application that is associated with the alert rule. Valid values:

- TRACE: Application Monitoring
- EBPF: Application Monitoring eBPF Edition

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-trace-apps --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --tags Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --biz-region cn-shenzhen --app-type TRACE --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListTraceApps --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value TestValue --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxyexli20000' --Region 'cn-shenzhen' --Tags.1.Key TestKey --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppType TRACE
